title: The Café at 2am
description: A Viennese café at night. A lone figure sits at a table with an envelope before them while the café owner watches from behind the bar. Through the window, military trucks and cheering crowds pass outside.
context: A private decision made while history turns monstrous outside. Good for secrets, letters, betrayal, political horror, or the moment a character realizes the world has changed.

title: Leaving Westbahnhof
description: A train departs Vienna at dawn. The city recedes through the window, with smoke, flags, and station architecture visible outside. A traveller sits inside, but the reflection in the glass is absent.
context: A vampire leaving a doomed city. The missing reflection signals Kindred nature without making the scene overtly monstrous.

title: The Officer and the Unclassifiable
description: An SS officer sits across a desk from something he cannot understand. Two cups of coffee and open files sit between them. Research materials cover the walls. The scene is lit by a single lamp.
context: A bureaucratic encounter with the supernatural. The mortal institution thinks it can study, categorize, or control the vampire, but fear is already present.

title: The Necessary Feeding
description: A figure in a long coat bends over a seated victim, face buried near the neck. Both figures are almost silhouettes, surrounded by deep shadow and gothic interior details.
context: A feeding scene presented as intimate and terrible rather than graphic. Useful for hunger, compulsion, and the emotional cost of survival.
use_cases: loss of control but no gore

title: The Barrel's Stare
description: A pistol is aimed directly at the viewer. The barrel dominates the image. Behind it, a shadowed face has already made a decision.
context: A direct threat, execution moment, intimidation attempt, or player-facing danger. The viewer is the target.

title: The City Watches
description: A rain-slicked gothic street at night with gas lamps, towering architecture, wet cobblestones, and one distant figure. Giant watching eyes loom in the storm-dark sky.
context: The city itself feels sentient, hostile, and observant. Use when the player is being watched or when paranoia becomes atmospheric.

title: The Necessary Feeding
description: A figure in a long coat bends over a seated victim, face buried near the neck. Both figures are almost silhouettes, surrounded by deep shadow and gothic interior details.
context: A feeding scene presented as intimate and terrible rather than graphic. Useful for hunger, compulsion, and the emotional cost of survival.
use_cases: loss of control but no gore

title: Names Taken by Fire
description: A pale hand holds a single sheet of paper burning in darkness. Names are barely visible as flame consumes the page and ash falls away.
context: Evidence, lineage, witnesses, debts, or identities are being erased. Good for cover-ups and irreversible decisions.

title: Unresolved Power
description: Two shadowed figures face each other across a narrow interior space. Faces are partially hidden. Their posture suggests negotiation, threat, or confrontation.
context: A tense social or political encounter where violence is possible but not yet chosen.

title: Too Light, Too Soon
description: A silhouetted figure moves quickly across gothic rooftops toward or away from a brightening horizon. The sky is dangerously light.
context: A vampire racing against dawn. Urgency without chaos. Every second matters.

title: The Barrel's Stare
description: A pistol is aimed directly at the viewer. The barrel dominates the image. Behind it, a shadowed face has already made a decision.
context: A direct threat, execution moment, intimidation attempt, or player-facing danger. The viewer is the target.

title: Impact Against Stone
description: Two figures collide violently, one driving the other backward into a wall. Plaster cracks, dust bursts, coats tangle, and neither face is clearly visible.
context: A physical combat impact moment. Use for raw force, supernatural strength, or a brutal turn in a fight.

title: Outcome Decided
description: One figure stands over another lying on the ground in a shadowed gothic interior. The standing figure is composed and still. The fallen figure is not getting up.
context: Aftermath of domination, combat, or judgement. Power has already been established.

title: Rain-Soaked Alley Aftermath
description: A modern figure in a long coat stands in a wet alley near a fallen body. Fire escape, neon sign, brick walls, and rain reflections create a noir urban mood.
context: Modern street-level vampire violence. A fight is over, and the standing figure controls the scene.

title: The Gun Belongs to No One
description: A weapon lies on a wet floor between one standing pair of feet and one collapsed pair. Candlelight comes from off frame. The fight is already over.
context: A tense aftermath image focused on consequence rather than action. The weapon is neutral, abandoned, or contested no longer.

title: Predator Geometry
description: A figure moves through deep shadow along a wall, pressed flat and watching a target ahead who is unaware. Modern urban architecture and night lighting create a stalking composition.
context: A stealth or hunting scene where the vampire has patience, time, and advantage.

title: The Street Is Silent
description: A torn-coated figure stands in the middle of a narrow street at 3am, face turned upward. Three bodies lie on the ground around them. The mood is not triumphant.
context: A violent scene where survival came at a cost. Best used when the Beast has won but the character has lost something human.

title: The Shadow Tells the Truth
description: A composed modern figure stands against a wall while their shadow is grotesquely elongated, angular, and inhuman. The person appears calm; the shadow reveals the Beast.
context: A visual metaphor for hidden monstrosity, internal contradiction, or supernatural aura leaking through.

title: Worse Than Violence
description: Two modern figures stand in deep shadow. One supports the other, who has gone slack and peaceful. The feeder's eyes are closed. The scene is intimate and uncomfortable, without gore.
context: A feeding scene focused on dependence, need, and emotional cost. It is calm, necessary, and morally heavy.

title: Too Much Weight
description: A central figure stands in a room while others turn toward them, lean in, and become drawn to their presence. A candle flame bends toward the figure.
context: A representation of supernatural Presence or social gravity. The figure is not performing; their existence bends attention.

title: Absent in Plain Sight
description: A sharp, clear figure stands in a crowded corridor or lobby while everyone moves around them without noticing. The figure is visible to the viewer but absent to the crowd.
context: A supernatural invisibility or social disappearance scene. Best for Obfuscate, being ignored, or moving unseen through public space.

title: Disappearing Into the Crowd
description: A vampire-like figure dissolves into heavy shadow among a crowded modern subway or station corridor. Commuters move around them, unaware.
context: A clearer discipline image for Obfuscate. The vampire is not absent completely; they are becoming part of the blind spot.

title: Rooftop Predator
description: A Nosferatu-like vampire crouches on a rooftop at night, looking down at a lone woman walking on the street below. The city is modern, wet, and lit by scattered urban lights.
context: The hunt from the predator's point of view. Strong image for Nosferatu, Obfuscate, stalking, Hunger, and predation.

title: Vitae as Power
description: A single drop of blood hangs above a gothic chalice surrounded by reaching hands, ritual geometry, and looming architecture. The drop is precious, magical, and ominous.
context: A symbolic representation of vitae as resource, power, temptation, and doom. Use broadly for blood mechanics and supernatural fuel.

title: The Beast in the Glass
description: A modern figure stands on a rain-soaked city street, hand raised toward a shop window. Their reflection does not match: crouched, feral, animal-like, with long hands and a spreading shadow. People pass without noticing.
context: A direct visual metaphor for Humanity and the Beast. The vampire appears composed, but the reflection reveals what lives underneath.

title: Two Cities Inside One
description: A split scene divided by a cracked marble pillar. On the left, a refined ballroom with chandeliers, maps, contracts, and a Ventrue addressing elegant figures. On the right, a basement with graffiti, pipes, a Brujah-led group, and anarchic energy. A thin-blood sits at the base of the crack, belonging to neither side.
context: A political metaphor for the Ivory Tower and the Anarchy existing in the same city, same building, same night. The thin-blood sees both worlds clearly.
